name: sortable
title: Sortable
description: A list whose items are put in order by dragging a handle or with the keys.
use: An order the reader decides: priorities, a playlist, the steps of a workflow, the lines of a quote, the columns of a table. Put it on a list, a stack of cards or the body of a table; each item has a handle named with what it moves.

instead.when: The order follows a column the reader picks
The items are only read in a fixed order
An item also moves between lists, such as the stages of a board

keyboard.action: On a handle, pick the item up; again, drop it where it is
Move the item that is picked up one place; ArrowLeft and ArrowRight in sortable-row, the other way around from right to left
Move the item that is picked up to the first or the last place
Put the item back where it was picked up, or where a drag started
Leave the handle, which drops the item

platform.fallback: The carried item takes its new place at once; the others are already there
The item is inserted again, and its handle is focused again

classes.name: sortable
classes.description: What holds the items: a list, a stack, or a table's tbody, one list to a body. While an item is carried the cursor is a closed hand

classes.name: sortable-row
classes.description: The items run across: the offset and the room the items make are horizontal

classes.name: sortable-item
classes.description: An item: a list's row, a card, or a table's row with table-row. It stands for its data-value, or its text. Carried, it keeps its size and drawing, rises on a raised sheet and follows the pointer; a table's row is its own sheet, drawn by the cell that holds the handle, so no cell moves

classes.name: sortable-item-back
classes.description: Set by the behavior during a drag on the items between the carried one's place and where it would land, when it is carried toward the end: each glides toward the start by --sortable-size

classes.name: sortable-item-forward
classes.description: Set by the behavior during a drag when the carried item goes toward the start: each item it passes glides toward the end by --sortable-size

classes.name: sortable-handle
classes.description: The button that carries the item, holding a grip icon: name it with what it moves. A 24 by 28px target, 44px on touch screens

classes.name: sortable-status
classes.description: A region that says each pick, move and drop, inside the root or right after it; right after the table when the root is a table's body, which holds only rows. It takes no room

states.name: carried
states.description: The item is picked up, by the pointer or the keys: the grip sits in a well and the item lifts

states.name: disabled
states.description: The item stays where it is

states.name: moving
states.description: Set by the behavior while the items change places: nothing glides but the view transition

properties.name: --sortable-offset
properties.description: How far the carried item is from its place along the list; the script writes it

properties.name: --sortable-size
properties.description: On the root during a drag: the carried item's size with the gap after it, the distance the others make room by; the script writes it

properties.name: --sortable-radius
properties.description: The corner of the sheet a carried item lifts on

properties.name: --sortable-inset
properties.description: How far the sheet reaches past a carried item's sides, and half as far past its top and bottom, for an item whose words stand on its edges. 0 for an item with a face of its own, such as a card; a table's row is always its own sheet

1. Onboarding
  2. Billing
